messages:
alex: seeing weird VRAM growth in paged-KV longctx runs on H100. seq=64k, batch=8, eviction rate spikes then memory keeps climbing. anyone seen similar?
priya: which branch / kernel set? any difference vs rtx runs?
dan: saw something like this once — PT slot reallocation oscillation caused reuse to drop. but that was with an older pager.
alex: running main@f3a2 with kernel-selector=autopick. repro command: ./tools/repro_paged_attn --model=gpt2 --seq=65536 --batch=8 --gpu=h100 --traces=kvtrace.log --pager=enabled
maria: can you paste the eviction counters? perf-bot might have telemetry.
perf-bot: evict_rate=124/s, reuse_hit=0.42, pt_frag=0.18, avg_free_run=12ms (from telemetry/1759012345-run1)
alex: attached a short snippet from kvtrace.log: ```EVICT idx=1024 owner=3 -> freed=0 (stale), remap_attempt=2
PT_ENTRY: slot=1024 owner=3 version=17 stale_flag=1
RELINK: slot=1024 -> new_slot=2048, decrement refcnt failed```
priya: stale_flag=1 is suspicious. can you repro with debug PT logging (PT_DEBUG=1) and run against mi250? want to see cross-arch diff.
dan: also try forcing kernel-selection to tiled_kernel_v2. on some hw the linear kernel shuffles page indices causing poor locality and early eviction of hot cache lines.
alex: did a quick run on mi250: ./tools/repro_paged_attn --model=gpt2 --seq=65536 --batch=8 --gpu=mi250 --pager=enabled --kernel=tiled_v2 --trace=mi250.log
alex: mi250 trace shows evict_rate=48/s reuse_hit=0.71 pt_frag=0.06. so much better. H100 with same kernel still bad.
maria: that points to a GPU-specific ordering/atomics difference. maybe our PT shadow remap uses relaxed atomics which are non-deterministic on H100 under NVLINK.
dan: agreed. I remember a race where two threads thought they owned the same slab index because our shadow map compare used stale owner id read without acquire semantics. On Ampere it was rare; on Hopper it amplifies.
priya: temporary mitigation: increase hysteresis in eviction heuristics so we avoid remap churn. Can we ship a config flip to Dedicated staging and run longctx soak?
alex: opened a quick PR with EVCT_HYST=32 -> 128. running overnight soak. also added PT compare with acquire semantics in branch fix/pt-acquire.
ci-bot: build #4892 for fix/pt-acquire started (h100,mi250). logs: https://ci/reports/4892
maria: if that fixes the churn we still need a proper root cause: kernel selection should be aware of PT access ordering characteristics per-arch. adding a perf task to quantify kernel vs PT ordering impact.
alex: created perf ticket: PERF-1187 — measure eviction patterns across kernel variants and HW. will attach flamegraphs and KV access heatmaps after soak.
priya: Thanks. if soak fails, collect a small repro with --trace-sample-rate=1 and drop the trace to /tmp and ping me. quick voice check tmrw if needed. :thumbsup:
alex: will do, thanks all.
